title: Command palette and shortcuts
summary: Everything that has a button also has a name in the command palette, and the main screens have keyboard shortcuts.
usage: Press Ctrl+K (⌘K on Mac) on any screen and type: go to a page or Settings tab, open a project, chat or organization (and its tabs), start a project or chat, search chats, open project notes, show live files, stop a request, change the work mode, theme or language, open notifications, check for updates, copy the diagnostics, open the documentation or sign out.
